name: rainwater-harvesting-studio
description: Parametric 3D modeller that calculates rainwater harvesting yield, tank size and reliability to BS EN 16941-1:2024. For architecture teaching.
author: Karam Al-Obaidi
comment: There are no dependencies and nothing to install. The app is a single HTML file with no build step; `npm test` runs on a bare Node 18+ install. This file exists for the scripts above and for the metadata.
